gloss: to sink; to set (sun); to be submerged; to die; to pass away (formal/literary); to be absorbed in; to be immersed in

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {没|ぼっ}していませんでした

definitions.gloss: to sink; to set (sun); to be submerged
definitions.explanation: To go below the surface or disappear from view, used in literary contexts for the setting of the sun or the sinking of ships.
A formal and literary way to say that someone has died, commonly used in biographical and historical writing.

definitions.gloss: to be absorbed in; to be immersed in
definitions.explanation: To become deeply engrossed in an activity or subject to the point of losing awareness of one's surroundings, most often seen in compounds like 没頭 and 没入.

examples.japanese: ⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{水平線|すいへいせん}→水平線：13311_suiheisen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{没|ぼっ}した。
examples.english: The sun sank below the horizon.
The ship sank in the storm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕日|ゆうひ}→夕日：04080_yuuhi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{向|む}こう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{没|ぼっ}していく⟦{光景|こうけい}→光景：02799_koukei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ほど⟦{美|うつく}しかった→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The scene of the setting sun sinking behind the mountains was breathtakingly beautiful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昨年|さくねん}→昨年：10433_sakunen⟧{没|ぼっ}した。
examples.english: My grandfather passed away last year.

examples.japanese: {没年|ぼつねん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不明|ふめい}→不明：11352_fumei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The year of death is said to be unknown.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{没頭|ぼっとう}している→没頭する：18376_bottousuru⟧。
examples.english: He is absorbed in his research.

examples.japanese: ⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{没頭|ぼっとう}する→没頭する：18376_bottousuru⟧あまり、⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I was so absorbed in my hobby that I lost track of time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{没入|ぼつにゅう}→没入：15051_botsunyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえなく→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I became so immersed in the world of the novel that I stopped hearing the voices around me.

notes:
A literary verb with multiple related meanings, all sharing the core idea of something sinking or disappearing. The character {没|ぼつ} means "to sink" or "to disappear."

USAGE:
- Sense 1 is mainly literary; in everyday speech, ⟦{沈|しず}む→沈む：02061_shizumu⟧ is more common
- Sense 2 is the formal/biographical way to say someone died; common in historical writing
- Sense 3 appears most often in the compound ⟦{没頭|ぼっとう}する→没頭する：18376_bottousuru⟧ (to be absorbed in) and ⟦{没入|ぼつにゅう}→没入：15051_botsunyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be immersed in)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{没|ぼっ}する: the sun sets
- {没年|ぼつねん}: year of death
- ⟦{没後|ぼつご}→没後：13275_botsugo⟧: after someone's death; posthumously
- ⟦{没頭|ぼっとう}する→没頭する：18376_bottousuru⟧: to be absorbed in
- ⟦{没入|ぼつにゅう}→没入：15051_botsunyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be immersed in
- ⟦{埋没|まいぼつ}→埋没：18541_maibotsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be buried; to fall into obscurity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{沈|しず}む→沈む：02061_shizumu⟧: to sink — the everyday equivalent for sense 1
- ⟦{亡|な}くなる→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧: to pass away — the standard euphemism for death
- ⟦{没頭|ぼっとう}する→没頭する：18376_bottousuru⟧: to be absorbed in — the most common compound using {没|ぼつ}
